# Italy vs Poland VNL Grand Finals Heat Map

```{r}
ball_data <- read_csv("C:/Users/RobTop/Documents/STA227 - Data Visualization/vb/ball_positions.csv")
ball_data$x_court <- -9 + ball_data$u * 18  # u in [0,1] mapped to [-9,9]
#ball_data$y_court <- ball_data$v * 9       # v in [0,1] mapped to [0,9]
y_min_clip <- 2.9
y_max_clip <- 9
ball_data$y_court <- pmax(pmin(ball_data$v * 9, y_max_clip), y_min_clip)  # clip
ball_data$y_court <- (ball_data$y_court - y_min_clip) / (y_max_clip - y_min_clip) * 9  # stretch to 0-9

z <- kde2d(
  x = ball_data$x_court,
  y = ball_data$y_court,
  n = 200,                  # higher resolution
  lims = c(-9, 9, 0, 9)
)
z$z <- sqrt(sqrt(z$z))#more sensitive

# 3. Set up plot with extra right margin for legend
par(mar = c(2,2,2,6))  # bottom, left, top, right

# 4. Plot heatmap
image(
  z,
  col = hcl.colors(20, "YlOrRd", rev = TRUE),  # more colors for sensitivity
  xlim = c(-9, 9),
  ylim = c(0, 9),
  axes = FALSE,
  xlab = "",
  ylab = "",
  main = "Volleyball Ball Heatmap"
)

# 5. Overlay court boundaries
rect(-9, 0, 9, 9, border = "black", lwd = 2)   # outer boundary
abline(v = 0, lwd = 2)                          # centerline (net)
abline(v = -3, lty = 2)                         # attack lines
abline(v = 3,  lty = 2)

# 6. Add half-court shading
rect(-9, 0, 0, 9, border = NA, col = rgb(0.9, 0.9, 1, 0.025))
rect(0, 0, 9, 9, border = NA, col = rgb(1, 0.9, 0.9, 0.025))

rect(-9, 0, -3, 9, border = NA, col = rgb(1, 1, 1, 0.1))  # Team A attack (dark red, transparent)
rect(-3, 0, 0, 9, border = NA, col = rgb(0.5, 0, 0, 0.1))      # Team A defense (white, transparent)
rect(3, 0, 9, 9, border = NA, col = rgb(1, 1, 1, 0.1))      # Team B attack (white, transparent)
rect(0, 0, 3, 9, border = NA, col = rgb(0, 0.5, 0, 0.1))    # Team B defense (dark green, transparent)


# 8. Optional team labels
text(-4.5, 8.5, "Poland", cex = 0.9)
text( 4.5, 8.5, "Italy", cex = 0.9)

# 9. Legend outside the court
cols <- hcl.colors(20, "YlOrRd", rev = TRUE)
legend_x <- 9.2
legend_y <- seq(0, 9, length.out = length(cols)+1)
for(i in 1:length(cols)){
  rect(legend_x, legend_y[i], legend_x + 0.5, legend_y[i+1], col = cols[i], border = NA)
}
# Add numerical labels for density
text(legend_x + 0.6, seq(0, 9, length.out=5), 
     labels = round(seq(min(z$z), max(z$z), length.out=5), 2), adj = 0)

summary(ball_data$y_court)
hist(ball_data$y_court, breaks = 20, main="Y distribution of ball", xlab="Court Y")

```

# Beach Volleyball - Beach VNL  

Located on Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/jessemostipak/beach-volleyball

```{r}
vb_data  <- read_csv("C:/Users/RobTop/Documents/STA227 - Data Visualization/vb_matches.csv")
vb_clean <- vb_data %>% mutate(duration_min = as.numeric(hms(duration)) / 60,w_p1_age = as.numeric(w_p1_age), l_p1_age = as.numeric(l_p1_age))
head(vb_data)

# Graph 1: Match duration by gender 
gf_histogram(~ duration_min, fill = ~ gender, data = vb_clean, bins = 20, alpha = 0.6) %>% gf_facet_wrap(~ gender, nrow = 2) %>%gf_labs(title = "Match Duration by Gender", x = "Duration (minutes)", y = "Count",fill = "Gender")%>%gf_theme(legend.position = "none")%>%gf_refine(scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("Male", "Female")))#idk why this wont relabel but ill revisit if I finalize it

# Graph 2: Age distribution
age_data <- data.frame(age = c(vb_clean$w_p1_age, vb_clean$l_p1_age))
gf_histogram(~ age, data = age_data, bins = 20, fill="darkred") %>%gf_labs(title = "Age Distribution of Players",x = "Age", y = "Count")

# Graph 3: Age comparison winners vs losers
all_ages <- data.frame(age = c(vb_clean$w_p1_age, vb_clean$l_p1_age),outcome = rep(c("Winner", "Loser"), each = nrow(vb_clean)))
gf_density(~ age, fill = ~ outcome, data = all_ages, alpha=.5) %>%gf_labs(title = "Age Distribution: Winners vs Losers",x = "Age", y = "Density", fill = "Outcome")

# Graph 4: Age Difference

vb_clean = vb_clean %>%mutate(age_diff = w_p1_age + w_p2_age - l_p1_age - l_p2_age)
gf_histogram(~age_diff, data = vb_clean, bins = 20, fill = "lightblue") %>% gf_labs(title = "Winner Age - Loser Age Distribution",  x = "Age Difference")
```



# PlusLiga '08-'23 - Indoor Volleyball

Data on Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/kacpergregorowicz/-mens-volleyball-plusliga-20082022

```{r}
plugliga <- read_csv("C:/Users/RobTop/Documents/STA227 - Data Visualization/Mens-Volleyball-PlusLiga-2008-2023.csv")
plugliga <- plugliga %>% mutate(Date = dmy_hm(Date), Year = year(Date), Winner = factor(Winner, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Team_2", "Team_1")),T1_Att_Eff = as.numeric(T1_Att_Eff), T2_Att_Eff = as.numeric(T2_Att_Eff))
head(plugliga)

# Graph 1: Serve effectiveness comparison
gf_point(jitter(as.numeric(T2_Srv_Eff)) ~ jitter(as.numeric(T1_Srv_Eff)), data = plugliga, color = ~Winner, alpha = 0.6) %>% gf_labs(title = "Serve Effectiveness: Team 1 vs Team 2", x = "Team 1 Serve Efficiency", y = "Team 2 Serve Efficiency")%>%gf_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", alpha=.2)

# Graph 2: Reception vs attack
gf_point(as.numeric(T1_Att_Kill_Perc) ~ as.numeric(T1_Rec_Perf), data = plugliga, alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue")  %>% gf_labs(title = "Reception Quality vs Attack Kill Percentage", x = "Reception Performance", y = "Attack Kill Percentage")

# Graph 3: Blocking performance Overlay
gf_histogram(~T1_Blk_Sum, data = plugliga, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.3,binwidth = 1) %>% gf_histogram(~T2_Blk_Sum, data = plugliga, fill = "orange", alpha = 0.3,binwidth = 1) %>% gf_labs(title = "Distribution of Blocks - Both Teams Overlaid", x = "Blocks", y = "Count")

# Graph 4: Blocking performance Summed
gf_histogram(~(T1_Blk_Sum + T2_Blk_Sum), data = plugliga, alpha = 0.5, position = "stack",binwidth = 1, fill = "darkred") %>%gf_labs(title = "Distribution of Blocks - Both Teams Combined", x = "Blocks", y = "Count")

```
